text:
Maya Chen: Quick ask — we need a compact 'microbench kit' for next-week push. Focus: sharable, low-effort, brand-safe. Deliverables should be easy for growth to drop into socials, the webinar page, and a sales one-sheet.

Maya Chen: Items (priority): 1) three social tiles (1080x1080) with single-stat headlines + 1-line context; 2) hero banner (1200x628) for webinar/email; 3) printable one-pager PDF (single page); 4) 16:9 slide master; 5) small SVG mini-diagram showing cost index + 2 callouts; 6) localization CSV (en/fr/es).

Aisha Noor: Can take tiles + hero. Quick q: prefer iconography or photo background for tiles?

Maya Chen: Iconography — keeps file size small and localizable. Use brand gradients sparingly (brand-2 for highlights).

Gabe Mills: I'll produce the SVG mini-diagram. Confirm metric: show normalized "cost per 1k tokens" index and indicate % delta vs baseline.

Maya Chen: Yes, normalized index + small footnote: "Internal test configs; results may vary." Legal has approved that phrasing.

Sofia Li: Copy: I'll draft three 1-line contexts and alt text. Tone: friendly, pragmatic, not overly technical. Example headline language: "Up to 3x lower per-token cost in our tests."

Aisha Noor: I will include dark-mode variants for hero and tiles. Also adding a Figma page with components so localization team can swap strings easily.

Gabe Mills: File formats requested?

Maya Chen: PNG exports (tiles + hero), layered Figma file, single-page PDF for the one-pager, SVG + PNG for the diagram, and a CSV for strings: id,en,fr,es,alt_en,alt_fr,alt_es.

Sofia Li: Accessibility note: ensure body text contrast >=4.5:1 and hero CTAs meet 44x44px touch target.

Maya Chen: Good call. Also we need a naming convention: use this pattern:
```
redwood_microbench_<asset>_<size>_<locale>_<variant>_v1.png
```
example: redwood_microbench_tile_1080_en_primary_v1.png

Aisha Noor: Timeline: first comps by Tue 5pm PT, localization CSV Wed 10am, final exports Thu 8am PT. Is that acceptable?

Maya Chen: That works. Growth will append UTM params: utm_campaign=microbench_launch&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic. CTA for form: "Request a cost review" — sales ops already confirmed.

Gabe Mills: Pushing initial SVG sketch to the Figma board now. Will need the exact benchmark numbers to annotate percent deltas.

Sofia Li: Dropping copy pack + alt text into the figma comments. Includes 2 webinar subject lines and 3 email headers.

BenchBot (automations): Checklist created: [Brief logged] ✅ [Figma created] ✅ [Strings CSV created] ⬜ [Final exports uploaded] ⬜. Reminder: tag /deliverable when uploads are complete.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. If anything legal/localization blocks, flag me immediately. Otherwise, first pass Tue evening and we aim to publish next Thu across channels. :rocket:
